claims.claim: 2008-2015 RX350 / ES350 / IS250 / Camry engines included
claims.evidence: No brand or model markings are legible on any engine in either photo; witness notes mixed models with no identifiers.
No shipping labels, container manifest, or country-of-origin markings are visible in the photos.
Photos show static engines being visually inspected; no video, sound, or test rig evidence is shown.
No odometer, tag, or paperwork visible; mileage cannot be read from stacked bare blocks.
Timing covers and pulleys are seen attached, but this does not confirm internal seals or an unopened block; no close-up of seals/bolts shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (knock, worn bearings, cracked block) despite seller claim
risks.proof: A running video with audio (cold start, idle, revved) or a compression/leak-down test clip per engine
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-running/for-parts until a running clip is provided

risks.risk: Model/engine size mismatch - buyer may receive a different engine than the model promised
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine ID tag, casting number, or VIN-linked sticker matching the claimed model
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic used engine, not the specific premium model claimed

risks.risk: Mileage and import history (Tokunbo/Belgium origin) cannot be confirmed, so it could be a locally sourced or higher-mileage unit misrepresented as low-mileage import
risks.proof: Bill of lading, import duty receipt, or odometer/ECU readout photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified-origin used engine, not as a verified low-mileage Tokunbo import

risks.risk: Completeness - engine may be missing turbo, sensors, wiring harness, or ECU needed for installation
risks.proof: Full 360° close-up photos of each engine showing intake, turbo housing, harness connectors, and sensors
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete/core engine requiring additional parts

risks.risk: Lot composition ambiguity - unclear if buyer is paying for one engine or the whole mixed container
risks.proof: Seller statement/invoice specifying unit count and whether sale is per-engine or whole-container
risks.if_unproven: priced as single generic engine unit, not the full container lot

proof_requests: Close-up photo of each engine's ID/casting tag or sticker showing model and engine code
Video of at least one representative engine cold-starting and idling with audible sound
Photo of import/shipping documents (bill of lading, customs clearance) showing Belgium origin
Photo/video of odometer or ECU mileage readout if available
Clarification on whether sale is per-unit or for the entire container, with unit count
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a bulk lot of used, unbranded car engines in mixed condition, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified origin, functionality, and model match) while the seller's strong claims remain unproven and would need documentary or video proof to raise the price.
